Name: New Krobus to match DC Burger's portraits
Author: kitchenarm
Description:
This is just an xnb file to replace Krobus' sprite to make it look more like his portrait in 'DC Burgers new portraits' mod.

[u]Download instructions[/u]
[list]
[*]download and unzip file (back up your vanilla characters first!!!)
[*]go into your stardew valley folder
[*]copy and paste Krobus.xnb into your characters file
[*]enjoy!!!
[/list]
This is my very first sprite edit so if there are any glitches or inconsistencies please let me know!
